info.title: Accounting API
info.description: Accounting API for the first-party SPA and third-party systems. Contract: .docs/API-CONTRACT.md.

post.summary: Issue an access token

get.summary:
Accounts of the company, ordered by code unless `sort` says otherwise. Filters: `filter[class]`,
`filter[status]`, `filter[parent_id]` and `filter[search]` (code prefix or part of the name).
`per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Adds an account. The saldo normal defaults to that of the class; the parent must be active and
of the same class. The posting attributes default to an account that restricts nothing:
`allowed_sources`, `dimension_requirements` (dimension type key => `required`/`optional`/`forbidden`),
`currency_restriction` (with `restricted_currency` for `specific`) and `is_revaluable`

patch.summary:
Changes code, name, saldo normal, parent or posting attributes. `lock_version` is required; the class
cannot change. Posting attributes apply to postings from now on; existing journals are not re-checked

post.summary: Deactivates the account. Refused while it has active children
Reactivates the account. Refused while its parent is inactive

get.summary:
Every account role of the ledger with the account that plays it now, or `null` when it is not
mapped. `valid` is false when that account no longer qualifies (inactive, for example), and
`required` names the situation in which a missing mapping blocks a feature

lock_version.description: The version of the mapping (0 when none), named as the concurrency field (API-TR-14).

put.summary:
Maps the role to an account as a new version; the change is audited. The account must be an active
leaf of the company in a class the role accepts. `lock_version` is the one you read (0 when the role
is not mapped yet) and `effective_date` defaults to today, or to all dates for the first mapping of a role

get.summary: Chart of accounts templates the company can review. A template is only a suggestion

Every account of a template with its class, saldo normal, parent and whether it is optional,
for review before the import is confirmed

post.summary:
Creates the accounts of a template in an empty chart. `confirmed` must be true: the template
is only a suggestion until the company confirms it. Optional leaf accounts can be left out
with `exclude`

get.summary:
Allocations, newest first. Filters: `filter[open_item_id]` (on either side), `filter[document_id]`
and `filter[status]`. `per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Settles an amount of two open items of the same party, control account and currency against each
other, one on the debit side and one on the credit side, for example an advance against an invoice.
Makes no journal
Cancels an active allocation with a reason. The open items it settled open again by its amount

get.summary:
The current approval policy (TE-FR-09). A company that never set one has version 0 and no rules:
every entry then needs one approval by a holder of `entries.approve`

put.summary:
Replaces the policy as a new version; the change is audited. Answers 422 for a transaction type
key or permission that does not exist. `lock_version` is required

get.summary:
Cash and bank accounts of the company, ordered by name. Filters: `filter[status]`,
`filter[kind]` (`cash` or `bank`). `per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Adds a cash box or bank account. Its currency must be activated for the company, and its
ledger account must be an active asset leaf that accepts the `subledger` source only and the
currency, and that no other cash account uses. A bank account needs `bank_name` and
`account_number`; a cash box has neither

patch.summary:
Changes the name or the bank details. The kind, currency and ledger account cannot change.
`lock_version` is required

post.summary: Deactivates the account. Its history stays readable
Reactivates the account

get.summary:
Cash transactions, newest first. Filters: `filter[cash_account_id]`, `filter[cleared]`,
`filter[date_from]` and `filter[date_to]` on the transaction date. `per_page` defaults to 50,
at most 200. Transactions are recorded by the documents that move cash, not through this API

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Marks the transaction cleared on `cleared_on` (today when empty, never in the future or before
the transaction date). The date and the user are kept and the change is audited
Takes the cleared mark off the transaction; the change is audited

get.summary: The company profile and status

patch.summary:
Changes the profile. `lock_version` is required; the functional currency can only change while
the company is in `setup`

post.summary: Makes the company inactive: its data becomes read-only
Brings an inactive company back to `active`

Activates the company (`setup` to `active`). Answers 422 `COMPANY_NOT_READY` with the missing
prerequisites in `errors` when the chart of accounts, calendar or other setup is incomplete

get.summary:
Currencies the company has activated, functional currency first. Filters: `filter[status]` and
`filter[search]` (code prefix or part of the name). `per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Activates a currency from the ISO 4217 reference. `scale` defaults to the ISO minor unit and
`rounding_mode` to `half_up`

patch.summary:
Changes the scale or rounding mode. `lock_version` is required; the scale of the functional
currency can only change while the company is in `setup`

post.summary: Deactivates the currency. The functional currency is always active
Reactivates the currency

get.summary:
Dimension types of the company, ordered by key. Filter: `filter[status]`. `per_page` defaults
to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Adds a dimension type. The key is stable and cannot change afterwards

patch.summary:
Changes label, hierarchy flag or leaf-only rule. `lock_version` is required; a type cannot stop
being hierarchical while values have a parent

post.summary: Deactivates the type: its values can no longer be used in new transactions
Reactivates the type

get.summary:
Dimension values of the company, ordered by code unless `sort` says otherwise. Filters:
`filter[dimension_type_id]`, `filter[status]`, `filter[parent_id]` and `filter[search]` (code
prefix or part of the name). `per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Adds a value to an active type. The parent (hierarchical types only) must be an active value
of the same type. `valid_from` and `valid_to` are optional

patch.summary:
Changes code, name, parent or validity. `lock_version` is required; the type cannot change and
a parent that would form a cycle is refused

delete.summary:
Deletes a value that was never used. A value with children or that is part of a dimension set
can only be deactivated

post.summary: Deactivates the value. Refused while it has active children
Reactivates the value. Refused while its parent or its type is inactive

get.summary:
Documents, newest first. Filters: `filter[party_id]`, `filter[kind]`, `filter[date_from]` and
`filter[date_to]` on the date of the document. `per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200. Documents
are recorded by entries that have a subledger route, not through this API

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.summary:
Entries of the company, newest accounting date first unless `sort` says otherwise. Filters:
`filter[status]`, `filter[transaction_type_key]`, `filter[auto_reversal_status]` (`failed` lists the
scheduled reversals that did not go through, TE-FR-11), `filter[from]` and `filter[to]` (accounting date).
`per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Creates a draft entry on the latest published version of the transaction type, or on the
requested `transaction_type_version`. A `free_lines` version takes `lines`; a `structured` one takes
`values` and the lines come from its posting rules. The entry number is issued now

get.summary: One entry with its approval trail

patch.summary: Replaces the content of a draft. `lock_version` is required

post.summary: Validates the draft against the ledger rules and sends it to approval
Rejects a submitted entry; `reason` is required
Posts an approved entry to the ledger. Posting again returns the same journal
Takes a rejected entry back to draft
Cancels a draft or rejected entry; it stays readable
Adds a file (multipart field `file`) to an entry that is not posted or cancelled

delete.summary: Takes a file off an entry that is still a draft or rejected; the record is kept

get.summary:
Exchange rates, newest effective date first. By default only the current version of each rate
is listed. Filters: `filter[rate_type]` (key), `filter[currency]`, `filter[from]` and
`filter[to]` (effective date), and `filter[include_superseded]=1` to list every version.
`per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Records the rate of a foreign currency for a rate type and an effective date, as functional
currency per 1 unit. A different rate for the same type, currency and date is recorded as a
new version (a correction); the same rate again changes nothing and answers 200 with the
existing version. The functional currency and currencies that are not activated are refused

get.summary:
The rate that applies on `date`: the latest version of the rate with the latest effective date
on or before it, for the rate type and currency. Answers `EXCHANGE_RATE_NOT_FOUND` when there is
none or the newest one is older than the age limit of the rate type; it never falls back to 1,
another rate type or a cross rate (MD-FR-08)

post.summary:
Imports rates from CSV, as a multipart `file` or a `text/csv` body. Columns: `rate_type`,
`currency`, `effective_date`, `rate`. At most 1000 rows. All or nothing: any invalid row
rejects the whole file and every problem is listed under `rows.<line>.<field>`

Sends a financial event (TE-FR-12). It becomes an entry of the source `integration`, is validated
and submitted, and follows the approval policy like any entry; an approver, never the client,
decides. 201 with the identity and status of the event; 200 with the original result when the same content
comes again under its source key, 409 SOURCE_TRANSACTION_CONFLICT when other content does (TE-FR-13). 422 for a payload or a configuration that
does not hold, with nothing recorded; 403 for a transaction type outside the allowlist of the client

get.summary:
The changes feed (TE-FR-15): the steps events took, oldest first, after `cursor` (from the start when
absent). Poll with `meta.next_cursor` of the last page; each step comes once and in order. A client
sees the steps of its own events, a user with `financial-events.read` those of all

Where an event stands. A client sees only what it sent; a user needs `financial-events.read`.
Another client's event is 404, not 403
The fiscal calendar of the company. Answers 404 until it has been set up

post.summary:
Sets up the calendar: how a fiscal year is cut into periods (`monthly`, `four_four_five` or
`free`) and, for `monthly`, the month it starts. Answers 409 when the company already has one

patch.summary:
Changes the calendar. `lock_version` is required; a real change is refused with 409 once
fiscal years exist

get.summary: Fiscal years of the company in date order, with their number of periods

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Creates `count` fiscal years (default 1), cut by the pattern of the calendar: twelve calendar
months, twelve periods of 4, 4 and 5 weeks (`extra_week` makes a 53-week year), or the `periods`
you list for a free calendar. The first year needs `start_date`; later years continue the
previous one. Answers 422 `MAPPING_REQUIRED` while the fiscal calendar has not been set up

get.summary: A fiscal year with all its periods

Where the fiscal year stands in its closing (GL-FR-12): whether it is closed, the closing in
force, and the checks that keep it from closing now: `retained_earnings` is mapped,
`last_period` accepts the closing journal, and no entry dated up to the end of the year is
unfinished (`unfinished_entries.count`, whatever the data scope of the caller). `ready` is true
when all pass. Answers 404 for a year of another company

post.summary:
Closes the fiscal year (GL-FR-12): one `system.closing` journal dated its last day brings every
income and expense account to zero per dimension set against the `retained_earnings` account.
Balance sheet accounts carry on into the next year. Answers 201 with the closing, or 200 when
the year was closed already and nothing was posted. Answers 409 `INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` while
entries dated up to the end of the year are unfinished, 422 `MAPPING_REQUIRED` without a
`retained_earnings` mapping, 422 `UNBALANCED_ENTRY` when the ledger does not balance and 422
`PERIOD_NOT_OPEN` when the last period does not accept the closing journal

Reopens a closed fiscal year (GL-FR-14): the closing journal is reversed on the last day of the
year, and the year can be closed again with a new closing. Needs a `reason`, which is audited.
Answers 409 `INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` when the year is not closed and 422 `PERIOD_NOT_OPEN` when
the period of the last day does not accept the reversal: reopen that period first. While a year is
closed, the ledger accepts no posting into it

get.summary: The history import of the company (GL-FR-11); 404 before the import

post.summary:
Imports the history between the ledger start and the cutover date as `system.history_import`
journals, atomically, and checks the ledger against the source trial balance at the cutover
date (GL-FR-11). Answers 201 with the import, or 200 when the same `source_key` and content were
imported before. Answers 409 `INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` without an opening balance batch, when
the batch has no history to import or when another import exists, 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`
for a known `source_key` with other content, 422 `MAPPING_REQUIRED` for a code without a
mapping, and 422 for dates outside the history, a period summarised twice, journals that the
posting rules refuse, or a ledger that differs from the source trial balance

get.summary:
Integration clients of the company, newest first. Filter: `filter[status]` is `active` or
`revoked`. `per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200. Secrets are never listed

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Registers a client for one `source_system`. The response carries `client_id` and
`client_secret`; the secret is shown this once and only its hash is kept. The client then
requests tokens at `POST /api/v1/oauth/token` with `grant_type=client_credentials` and HTTP
Basic authentication (`client_secret_basic`)

patch.summary: Renames the client or replaces its scopes or transaction type allowlist. `lock_version` is required

post.summary: Replaces the secret and revokes all active tokens at once. The new secret is shown this once
Revokes the client for good: its tokens stop at once and no new ones are issued

Accepts an invitation with the token from the email. The signed-in user must have a verified
email equal to the invited address. Answers the workspace that was joined

get.summary: Invitations of the workspace, newest first. `per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Emails an invitation with the given roles. `expires_at` is when the membership lapses once
accepted. A new invitation replaces an open one for the same address
Withdraws a pending invitation

get.summary:
The ISO 4217 reference a company activates currencies from, ordered by code. Filter:
`filter[search]` (code prefix or part of the name). `per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.summary:
Posted journals with their lines, newest first. This is the drill-down of the reports.
Filters: `filter[account_id]` (journals that touch the account), `filter[from]` and
`filter[to]` (accounting date), `filter[source]`, `filter[transaction_type_key]` and
`filter[dimensions][<type key>]=<value id>` (journals with a line in that value or below it).
Lines carry their `dimensions` as type key => value ID.
A user limited to some dimension values (IA-FR-03) sees only journals with a line inside that
scope, and only those lines; such journals have `scope_restricted` true.
`per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.summary: One journal with its lines; for a user with a data scope only the lines inside it, and 404 when there are none

post.summary:
Asks for the reversal of a posted journal (TE-FR-11): creates a draft entry of the type
`system.reversal` and returns it. Submit, approve and post it like any entry; the policy decides
who must approve. A journal is reversed in full and only once; 404 for a journal that does not
exist or that the caller does not see entirely, 409 when it was reversed already or a request is
under way, 422 when the period of `reversal_date` does not accept the posting

get.summary:
The current ledger policy: which transaction type keys, and which permission, may still post into
a soft-closed period. A company that never set one has version 0, and a soft-closed period then
accepts no posting

put.summary:
Replaces the policy as a new version; the change is audited. Answers 422 for a transaction type
key or permission that does not exist. `lock_version` is required

get.summary:
The signed-in user. Answers 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` when there is no session, which is how the
SPA learns that it must show the login screen
Workspaces the signed-in user can access right now: active, unexpired memberships only

Members of the workspace with their roles, ordered by name. Filter: `filter[status]` is
`active`, `revoked` or `expired`. `per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

patch.summary:
Changes the expiry date, replaces the roles or replaces the data scope of a member.
`lock_version` is required

post.summary:
Revokes the membership: access stops from the next request; audit records stay. You cannot
revoke your own membership

get.summary:
Open items, oldest due date first. Filters: `filter[party_id]`, `filter[control_role]`,
`filter[kind]`, `filter[status]` and `filter[due_to]` (due on or before the date). `per_page`
defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
Answers 201 with the run and the adjustments, or 200 with `id: null` when nothing needed adjusting.
Running again only posts what changed since the last run. Answers 422 `MAPPING_REQUIRED` when the
policy has no rate type or a role is not mapped, 422 `EXCHANGE_RATE_NOT_FOUND` when a currency has no
closing rate, and 422 when an allocation is dated after the period.
post.summary:
Revalues the foreign currency open items as of the last day of the period, at the closing rate of the
rate type named by the ledger policy (SL-FR-07). The difference is posted as a `system.fx_revaluation`
journal to the control accounts and the unrealized gain or loss accounts; with auto-reversal in the
policy, its reversal is dated the first day of the next period

get.summary: The opening balance batch of the company (GL-FR-11); 404 before the import

post.summary:
Imports the opening balances as one `system.opening_balance` journal dated `ledger_start_date`,
atomically (GL-FR-11). Answers 201 with the batch, or 200 when the same `source_key` and content
were imported before and nothing was posted. Answers 422 `MAPPING_REQUIRED` for a source account
or dimension value code without a mapping, 422 for a batch that does not balance, for accounts
or dimensions that the posting rules refuse, or for a line on a control account of a subledger
that differs from its open items; 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` for a known `source_key` with other
content and 409 `INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` when the company already has opening balances

get.summary:
Parties of the company, ordered by name. Filters: `filter[status]`, `filter[role]`
(`customer` or `supplier`), `filter[search]` (part of the name), and `filter[source_system]`
with `filter[external_ref]` to find the party a source system refers to. `per_page`
defaults to 50, at most 200

parameters.name: filter[source_system]
parameters.description: A reference only identifies a party together with its source system.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Adds a party with at least one role, optionally with the references source systems use for it.
A reference already mapped to another party of the same source system is rejected

patch.summary: Changes a party and adds references. `lock_version` is required

post.summary: Deactivates the party. It stays resolvable by its references and keeps its history
Reactivates the party

get.summary:
Periods in date order. Filters: `filter[fiscal_year_id]`, `filter[status]` and `filter[date]`
(the period that contains the date). `per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

parameters.name: filter[date]
parameters.description: The period that contains this date.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Soft-closes an open period: it accepts only the postings that the ledger policy names (the
transaction type keys and permission of `GET /ledger-policy`). An optional `reason` is audited

Closes an open or soft-closed period: it no longer accepts any posting. An optional `reason`
is audited
Reopens a soft-closed or closed period. A `reason` is required and is audited with the actor

get.summary:
The permissions the system knows, as keys a role can hold. The catalog is fixed by the system
and not paginated

Posting profiles of the company ordered by name, each with the account that plays every
control role now (`null` when it is not mapped). `valid` is false when that account no longer
qualifies, for example because it was deactivated

lock_version.description: The version of the mapping (0 when none), named as the concurrency field (API-TR-14).

post.summary:
Adds a profile. The first profile of the company becomes the default; later ones only when
`is_default` is true, which moves the default

lock_version.description: The version of the mapping (0 when none), named as the concurrency field (API-TR-14).
The version of the mapping (0 when none), named as the concurrency field (API-TR-14).

patch.summary:
Renames the profile or makes it the default. The default cannot be cleared, only moved to
another profile. `lock_version` is required

lock_version.description: The version of the mapping (0 when none), named as the concurrency field (API-TR-14).

put.summary:
Maps a control role of the profile to an account as a new version; the change is audited.
The account must be an active leaf of the right class (asset for `receivables_control`,
liability for `payables_control`) that accepts the `subledger` source only. `lock_version`
is the latest version of that role (0 when never mapped). `effective_date` defaults to today,
or to all dates for the first mapping

lock_version.description: The version of the mapping (0 when none), named as the concurrency field (API-TR-14).

get.summary:
Rate types of the company, ordered by key. Filter: `filter[status]`. `per_page` defaults to 50,
at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Adds a rate type. The key is stable and cannot change afterwards

patch.summary: Changes the label or the age limit. `lock_version` is required

post.summary: Deactivates the type: no new rates can be recorded for it; existing rates stay readable
Reactivates the type

get.summary: Schedules of the company; `filter[status]` narrows them. Those with a `last_error` are the ones that are stuck

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Creates a schedule that makes an entry of the transaction type on `start_date` and then every
`interval_count` of the `frequency` (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly), until `end_date`.
The entries are left as `draft` or `submitted` (`initial_status`)

put.summary: Replaces the template, end date, status (`active` or `paused`) and where entries are left. `lock_version` is required

post.summary: Gives up the date the schedule is stuck at, or waiting at, and goes on to the next

post.description:
Answers 201 with the run and the adjustments, or 200 with `id: null` when nothing needed adjusting.
Running again only posts what changed since the last run. Answers 422 `MAPPING_REQUIRED` when the
policy has no rate type or the unrealized gain or loss role is not mapped, and 422
`EXCHANGE_RATE_NOT_FOUND` when a currency has no closing rate.
post.summary:
Revalues the foreign currency balances of the accounts marked for revaluation, as of the last day
of the period, at the closing rate of the rate type named by the ledger policy (GL-FR-09). Control
accounts of a subledger are left out. The difference is posted as a `system.fx_revaluation`
journal; with auto-reversal in the policy, its reversal is dated the first day of the next period

get.summary:
Roles of the company with their permissions, ordered by name. Filter: `filter[is_active]`.
`per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Adds a role with the given catalog permissions. Names are unique within the company

patch.summary:
Renames the role or replaces its permissions; holders get the change from their next request.
`lock_version` is required

post.summary: Deactivates the role: it grants nothing until reactivated, and its holders keep it assigned
Reactivates the role

get.summary:
The current security policy: permissions that need 2FA, the idle session limit and the IP
allowlist of integration clients. A company that never set one has version 0 and no requirements

put.summary:
Replaces the policy as a new version; the change is audited and takes effect from the next
request. A user without 2FA is refused the listed permissions with `TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED`.
`lock_version` is required

get.summary: Transaction types of the company with their versions, ordered by key

post.summary: Defines a transaction type with a published first version in `free_lines` mode

put.summary: Sets the number series of a type and when its entries are numbered (TE-FR-16)

get.summary: Transaction type templates the company can review. A template is only a suggestion
Every type of a template with its mode, fields, posting rules and subledger route, for review before the import is confirmed

post.summary:
Creates the picked types of a template, each with a published first version. `confirmed` must be
true: the template is only a suggestion until the company confirms it. Fails as a whole when a key
is already used in the company
Starts a draft with the next version number

get.summary: The field schema of a version as a JSON Schema document; a free-lines version has no schema

put.summary: Replaces the content of a draft version

get.summary:
Trial balance for `from`..`to`: opening balance (the ledger before `from`), movement and
closing balance per account, totals and `balanced`. `account_id` narrows it to one account and `dimensions[<type key>]=<value id>` to the lines in that
value or any value below it (roll-up).
Drill down to the journals with `journals?filter[account_id]=&filter[from]=&filter[to]=`.
With `Accept: text/csv` the same report is downloaded, under the same permission (X-FR-02).
For a user limited to some dimension values only the lines inside that scope are added up and
`restricted` is true (IA-FR-03); the download is limited the same way

post.summary: Creates a workspace together with its company (status `setup`); the caller becomes its first member

sessionCookie.description: First-party SPA: session cookie from the login flow, plus the XSRF-TOKEN cookie echoed in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header on writes.
sessionCookie.name: accounting_session

bearerAuth.description: Integration clients: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials access token. Treat it as opaque. Writes require an Idempotency-Key header.

AccountClass.description: The five classes of the chart of accounts. A parent and its children share one class (GL-FR-01).
AccountClass.title: AccountClass

scale.description: Defaults to the ISO minor unit of the currency.

version.description: 0 while the company has never set a policy.

lock_version.description: Same as `version`, named as the concurrency field the update expects (API-TR-14).

CalendarPattern.description: How a fiscal year is cut into periods (GL-FR-03): calendar months, twelve periods of 4, 4 and 5 weeks per quarter, or periods the user gives explicitly.
CalendarPattern.title: CalendarPattern

cleared_on.description: The date the bank or cash count confirmed the transaction; today when empty.

journal_id.description: Null for a year without income or expense to close.

result.description: Profit (positive) or loss (negative) of the year moved to retained earnings.

reversal_journal_id.description: Set once the year was reopened and the closing journal reversed.

ControlRole.description: The control account roles of a posting profile (SL-FR-02). The keys are fixed by the product; which account plays a role is data per profile (P-01).
ControlRole.title: ControlRole

dimension_requirements.description: Dimension type key => `required`, `optional` or `forbidden`; types not listed are optional.

restricted_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the one foreign currency; only with the restriction `specific`.

normal_balance.description: Defaults to the normal balance of the class; the opposite is allowed for contra accounts.

bank_name.description: A bank account names its bank and number; a cash box has neither.

currency.description: The only currency of the account; it must be activated for the company.

account_id.description: The asset leaf account of the ledger that holds the balance; it accepts the subledger source only.

key.description: Stable identifier used in API payloads (`dimensions` objects, `dimensions[<key>]` filters).

start_date.description:
Required for the first year (the 1st of the start month of a monthly calendar, any date for
4-4-5; a free calendar takes it from its first period). Later years continue the previous
one, and a start date, when given, must equal that continuation.

name.description: Only with count 1; defaults to FY2026, or FY2026/2027 when the year does not start in January.

extra_week.description: 4-4-5 only: a 53-week year; the extra week goes to the last period. Only with count 1.

periods.description: Free calendar only, and then required: the periods of the one year, in order and without gaps.

is_customer.description: A party may be both; at least one role is required.

posting_profile_id.description: The profile deciding its control accounts; empty means the default profile (SL-FR-02).

external_refs.description: How source systems refer to this party; one reference belongs to one party per source system.

key.description: Stable identifier used in API payloads and rate lookups.

max_age_days.description: Rates older than this many days are not used for a date; empty means no limit (MD-FR-08).

key.description: Keys starting with `system.` are defined by code and contain a dot, which this pattern excludes.

CurrencyRestriction.description: Which transaction currencies an account accepts (GL-FR-02): the functional currency only, one specific foreign currency, or any.
CurrencyRestriction.title: CurrencyRestriction

CurrencyRounding.description: How amounts of a currency are rounded to its scale (MD-FR-06).
CurrencyRounding.title: CurrencyRounding

DimensionRequirement.description: Whether lines on an account must, may or must not carry a value of a dimension type (GL-FR-02).
DimensionRequirement.title: DimensionRequirement

DocumentKind.description: The kinds of document the subledger records (SL-FR-04). A mechanism of the system, not data a company defines: an invoice creates an open item; the others settle open items, and what they leave unsettled stays an open item of its own until it is allocated (SL-FR-05).
DocumentKind.title: DocumentKind

EntryRequest.description:
Content of a draft entry. Only the shape is checked here; accounts, period and balance are
validated when the entry is submitted (TE-FR-08). Amounts are decimal strings (API-TR-05).

lines.description: A free-lines entry carries `lines`, a structured one `values`; the version decides which is required.

auto_reverse_on.description: Date the system reverses the entry on once it is posted, and the posted entry it replaces (TE-FR-11).

currency.description: The currency and the rate a structured entry brings; a free-lines entry has them on each line (TE-FR-06).

values.description: Field name => value, by the field schema of the version (TE-FR-04).

EntryRequest.title: EntryRequest

EntryStatus.description: Lifecycle of an entry (TE-FR-07). `posted` and `cancelled` are final; a rejected manual entry can be revised.
EntryStatus.title: EntryStatus

FieldType.description: Types a field of a `structured` version can have (TE-FR-04).
FieldType.title: FieldType

FinancialEventRequest.description:
The canonical payload of a financial event (API-TR-17, API-TR-18). Only a client with the transaction
type on its allowlist may send it; the check comes before validation so that nothing is said about a
type the client may not use.
FinancialEventRequest.title: FinancialEventRequest

status.description: The status of the entry the event became; the journal is there once it is posted.

closing.description: The closing in force; null while the year is open, or after it was reopened.

ready.description: Whether every check passes, so the year can be closed now.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID for the token request; the secret is never readable again.
OAuth client ID for the token request; the secret is never readable again.

client_secret.description: Shown once. Store it now; only a hash is kept.

status.description: `pending`, `accepted`, `revoked`, or `expired` once the invitation lapsed unanswered.

data_scope.description: Dimension values the member is limited to once they accept; empty means unrestricted.

scope_restricted.description: True when the user's data scope hides lines, so `lines` may not add up to a balanced journal.

JournalSource.description: Where a posting command comes from (GL-FR-05). Which sources an account accepts is decided in M4-01.
JournalSource.title: JournalSource

version.description: 0 while the company has never set a policy.

lock_version.description: Same as `version`, named as the concurrency field the update expects (API-TR-14).

status.description: `active`, `revoked`, or `expired` once a set expiry has passed.

data_scope.description: Dimension values the member is limited to, each with its descendants; empty means no limit.

history_granularity.description: How the history between the two dates was imported; null until it is (GL-FR-11).

PeriodStatus.description: `open` accepts postings, `closed` refuses all of them; `soft_closed` accepts only what the ledger policy names (GL-FR-04).
PeriodStatus.title: PeriodStatus

ReasonRequest.description: Reason of a rejection (required) or a cancellation (optional), TE-FR-07.
ReasonRequest.title: ReasonRequest

rate.description: Up to 12 integer and 12 decimal digits, greater than zero, as a decimal string (API-TR-05).

RecurringScheduleRequest.description:
A recurring schedule (TE-FR-14). The template carries what an entry carries except its date, which
is the date of the occurrence: fixed values only, no formulas.
RecurringScheduleRequest.title: RecurringScheduleRequest

version.description: 0 while the company has never set a policy.

lock_version.description: Same as `version`, named as the concurrency field the update expects (API-TR-14).

start_month.description:
Month (1 = January) in which a monthly fiscal year starts; the year always starts on the 1st.
4-4-5 and free calendars start on the date of their first fiscal year instead.

TransactionTypeMode.description: How an entry becomes a journal (TE-FR-03).
TransactionTypeMode.title: TransactionTypeMode

dimension_requirements.description: Dimension type key => `required`, `optional` or `forbidden`; types not listed are optional.

restricted_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the one foreign currency; only with the restriction `specific`.

functional_currency.description: Only while the company is in setup (MD-AC-05); must be an ISO 4217 currency (MD-FR-06).

lines.description: A free-lines entry carries `lines`, a structured one `values`; the version decides which is required.

auto_reverse_on.description: Date the system reverses the entry on once it is posted, and the posted entry it replaces (TE-FR-11).

currency.description: The currency and the rate a structured entry brings; a free-lines entry has them on each line (TE-FR-06).

values.description: Field name => value, by the field schema of the version (TE-FR-04).

posting_profile_id.description: The profile deciding its control accounts; empty means the default profile (SL-FR-02).

VersionRequest.description:
Content of a draft version: the mode and, for `structured`, its field definitions (TE-FR-04).
Whether referenced accounts and dimension types exist is checked by the application layer.

allowed_currencies.description: Currencies and rates of entries (TE-FR-06); whether the currencies are active is checked by the application layer.

posting_rules.description: Posting rules of a structured version (TE-FR-05); what they refer to is checked by the application layer.

subledger_route.description: The document an entry of the version records in the subledger (TE-FR-10); how it fits the fields and rules is checked by the application layer.

VersionRequest.title: VersionRequest

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
